stage.name: Sacrificial Spot
stage.description: The tribesmen are conducting an ancient ceremony. A shadow flashes by during the bizarre rite, and a show is about to begin.
stage.source: mode level file; no stage_table row

seed_of_decay.name: Seed of Decay
seed_of_decay.flavourText: Originium Arts creation of the Nachzehrer King. It is a violation of the laws of nature, rejecting life for death. They create death for others to feed upon.
abilities: Self-destructs when near an Operator, dealing Physical damage

tiacauh_warrior.name: Tiacauh Warrior
tiacauh_warrior.flavourText: One of Acahualla's most commonly-seen warriors who uses a crude spear to attack. May pose unexpected difficulties if fighting at close range.

wasteland_robber.name: Wasteland Robber
wasteland_robber.flavourText: A member of a bandit gang operating in the wastelands using stolen weapons. They are not soldiers, and lack professional training, so stealing goods is more important to them than anything else.
abilities: Steals 1 DP from allied Operators after several attacks

tiacauh_ritualist.name: Tiacauh Ritualist
tiacauh_ritualist.flavourText: The very few Originium Arts users in Acahualla will often serve as doctors for their tribe. Despite not developing their Originium Arts, their medical experience lets them strike where it hurts.
abilities: Gains DEF when blocked, and deals Physical damage with melee attacks.

bounty_hunter_crossbowman.name: Bounty Hunter Crossbowman
bounty_hunter_crossbowman.flavourText: A bounty hunter adept at attacking from long-range. A little skilled, but nothing more. Moonlights as a bandit when there is no bounty to hunt.
abilities: After several attacks, the next attack deals splash damage to a cross area surrounding the target and steals DP equivalent to the number of targets hit

mossback_beast.name: Mossback Beast
mossback_beast.flavourText: A beast with moss growing on its back, appearing round and gentle but it is actually fierce with a terrible temper. The moss on its body has a hemostatic effect, and it will eat it when injured.
abilities: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked

luminous_fowlbeast.name: Luminous Fowlbeast
luminous_fowlbeast.flavourText: A small creature that can only be seen far from nomadic cities. With a flutter of its wings, it escapes once more into the shadows.
abilities: Upon taking damage, becomes Invulnerable and cannot move for a period of time

vesperwing.name: Vesperwing
vesperwing.flavourText: An Infected Creature that appears in dark places, often found in deep caves and abandoned buildings. It is easily startled, and will not hesitate to attack intruders who enter its territory.
abilities: Aerial unit, prioritizes attacking Holy Statue
Inflicts Bleed on allied Operators after several attacks

leporibeast_shorthorn.name: Leporibeast Shorthorn
leporibeast_shorthorn.flavourText: A herbivorous beast commonly found almost anywhere in the wild. It has small but sharp horns and is not aggressive, but will run and jump to avoid attacks when frightened. The meat is very tender.
abilities: After being attacked, runs away a random distance and rests for a period of time

leporibeast_longhorn.name: Leporibeast Longhorn
leporibeast_longhorn.flavourText: A herbivorous beast commonly found almost anywhere in the wild. It has grown large horns, but will still run away on reflex, jumping even higher and faster. The meat is very tender.
abilities: After being attacked, runs away a random distance and rests for a period of time

tiacauh_brave.name: Tiacauh Brave
tiacauh_brave.flavourText: A very formidable Tiacauh warrior, naturally born to do battle. These warriors harbor great pride in their combat abilities, and live for the thrill of the duel no matter where they are. Their single-mindedness allows them to shrug off all outside interference.
abilities: When blocked, this unit will only receive damage from the unit blocking it, and the DEF of both units is decreased.

devices.description: Only attacks wild animals. Can teleport to a random nearby deployable low area when there is no available target in range. Has 25% Physical and Arts dodge.
